description: Eclipse Devils is a team of developers and space enthusiasts in the 2026 NASA Space Apps Challenge. Tackling the "Build a Junior Astronaut Mission Trainer" challenge, we are creating an interactive, educational tool to prepare the next generation of space explorers. Combining smart technology, creative design, and real-world science, our goal is to make space exploration engaging, accessible, and fun for aspiring young astronauts!
summary:
Junior Astronaut Mission Trainer

Step into a space agency training terminal and earn your wings. Junior Astronaut Mission Trainer is an interactive learning game where you train like a real astronaut: explore a 3D solar system, float objects in a zero-gravity simulator, practice safety procedures, and complete five space missions, from a Moon landing to a visit to the International Space Station.

Test yourself with a 24-question astronomy quiz, earn XP, collect badges, and rise from Space Cadet to Galactic Explorer. Your progress saves automatically, no account or internet connection is needed once it’s loaded, and it works on both desktop and mobile.

Short version (one line): Train as an astronaut, explore the solar system, complete missions, and rank up from Space Cadet to Galactic Explorer.
details:
Junior Astronaut Mission Trainer 🚀

Junior Astronaut Mission Trainer is an interactive, space-themed educational platform designed to help students explore the fascinating world of space exploration through hands-on simulations, challenges, and missions.

The platform transforms traditional space learning into an engaging astronaut training experience. Users begin as Space Cadets and progress through different training modules, earning experience points (XP), completing missions, taking quizzes, and unlocking achievement badges.

Key Features

  • Space Knowledge: Explore educational content about astronomy and space science.
  • Zero-Gravity Simulator: Experiment with objects in simulated microgravity and compare their behaviour with Earth gravity.
  • Space Navigation: Explore an interactive 3D solar system and learn about planetary motion.
  • Astronaut Survival Training: Learn how astronauts approach different simulated space-related situations.
  • Mission Challenges: Complete interactive educational missions.
  • Knowledge Quizzes: Test understanding of space science and astronaut training.
  • Progress Tracking: Earn XP, collect badges, and monitor training achievements.

Technology

The website is developed using HTML, CSS, and vanilla JavaScript, with Three.js powering its interactive 3D solar system experience. User progress is stored locally in the browser.

Mission

Our mission is to make space education more accessible, interactive, and exciting by allowing students to experience astronaut training through a digital learning environment.

Explore. Learn. Train. Discover. Your journey to becoming a space explorer starts here!
